table.retrieve:
SELECT
	pocode=o.pocode,
	date=o.date,
	startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), 
	enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()),
	supplier=a.name,
	supplieralias = a.aliasname,
	username=u.username,
	ICode=St.Icode,
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	Item = i.name,
	Code = i.icatcode,
	packingdesc=max(i.packingdesc),
	Name = ic.Name,
	Manufacturer = M.Name,
	openqty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='OP' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	openvalue =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='OP' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	PurQty 	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='PV' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	PurValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='PV' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	PRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='PR' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	PRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='PR' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='SV' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='SV' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='SR' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='SR' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	IssueQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='IV' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	IssueValue=SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='IV' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='DS' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyValue=SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='DS' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptQty=SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='RV' THEN st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptValue=SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='RV' THEN st.value ELSE 0 END),
	AdjQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN st.type='AI' THEN st.qty WHEN type='AD' THEN -st.qty ELSE 0 END),
	AdjValue  =SUM(CASE  WHEN st.type='AI' THEN st.value WHEN type='AD' THEN -st.value ELSE 0 END),
	OrderQty = SUM(od.Qty),
	Rate = max(od.rate),
	DiscPerc = max(od.DiscPerc),
	BonusQty = SUM(od.BonusQty)
FROM
	Item i, 
	itemcategory ic,
	Manufacturer M,
	purorderheader o, 
	purorderdetail od,
	supplier s,
	accounts a,
	users u,
	(SELECT type='OP', a.icode, qty = sum(a.qty), value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, 
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND 
		pd.icode = po.icode and pl.date < po.startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode,
		qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*pl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND 
		pd.icode = po.icode and pl.date < po.startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND 
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND 
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date < po.startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode,
		qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.icode = po.icode and h.duesatisfydate < po.startdate
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(case pl.purcatcode when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				else (looseqty + bonusqty) end),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND 
		pd.icode = po.icode and pl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*pl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		pd.icode = po.icode and pl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.icode = po.icode and h.duesatisfydate BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sd.icode = po.icode and sl.date BETWEEN po.startdate and po.enddate 
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', item.icode, qty = 0, value=0 
	FROM ITEM,
		(select o.pocode, startdate=isnull(o.startdate, o.date), enddate=isnull(o.enddate, getdate()), od.icode
		from purorderheader o, purorderdetail od
		where o.POCode = :ai_code and o.pocode = od.pocode) po
	WHERE PO.Icode = Item.ICode) St
WHERE 
	o.POCode = :ai_code and
	o.suppcode = s.suppcode and
	s.suppcode = a.acccode and
	o.salesmancode = u.usercode and 
	o.pocode = od.pocode and
	st.icode = i.icode and
	i.icatcode = ic.icatcode AND
	i.manfcode = M.ManfCode and
	i.icode = od.icode
GROUP BY 
	o.pocode, o.date, o.startdate, o.enddate, a.name, a.aliasname, u.username, St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, i.icatcode, 
	ic.Name, M.Name, i.saleprice, i.packunits
ORDER BY 
	ic.name, i.name, M.Name

objects.name: compute_21
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN salevalue - sretvalue ELSE (saleqty - sretqty ) * rate) for all)=0,0,1)

objects.name: compute_19
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for all)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(openqty *  rate for all) + sum( purvalue - pretvalue for all)  + sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for all) - sum( salevalue - sretvalue for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(openqty *  rate for all) + sum( purvalue - pretvalue for all)  + sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for all) - sum( salevalue - sretvalue for all)

objects.name: closingstockqty
objects.expression: openqty + purqty - pretqty - saleqty + sretqty - duesatisfyqty - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty

objects.name: compute_13
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for group 1)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.visible: 0	if(sum(openqty *  rate for group 1) + sum( purvalue - pretvalue for group 1)  + sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for group 1) - sum( salevalue - sretvalue for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(openqty *  rate for group 1) + sum( purvalue - pretvalue for group 1)  + sum( receiptvalue + adjvalue - issuevalue - duesatisfyvalue for group 1) - sum( salevalue - sretvalue for group 1)
